title: Release guardrails and scope-relay for API/Console/Runtime launch
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create an operational playbook and set of guardrails for the upcoming coordinated launch of API, Console, and Runtime components. The deliverables are: (1) a tiered cut criteria matrix that teams can apply when deciding whether a change is included in the release (hard-cut, soft-cut, feature-flag), (2) a canonical release notes template and assignment map so the comms team can publish one coherent set of docs, (3) a milestone cadence with signoff owners and automated gating signals (test pass rate, perf regression threshold, canary metrics), and (4) a post-launch rollback/runbook mapping for cross-component degradations. This ticket covers alignment, documentation, and the roll-call of owners; implementation of infra gates (e.g., automated perf checks) tracked in dependent ENG tickets.
milestones: 2025-02-12: Draft cut-criteria matrix circulated to ENG/DES/SRE/SEC
2025-02-18: Finalize release notes template and owner roster

notes_and_decisions: Decision 2025-02-13: Adopt three-tier cut policy. Hard-cut = must pass all SLOs and security review; Soft-cut = allowed with feature flag and degraded SLA; Feature-flag-only = experimental and not included in release notes unless requested.
Trade-off 2025-02-15: To reduce release risk we will limit runtime kernel changes to non-critical paths. This reduces perf uplift potential but simplifies rollback.
Comms 2025-02-16: Release notes will be consolidated into a single canonical doc in Confluence; individual component leads must provide 1-paragraph PR summaries and severity tags by 2025-02-20.

Rollout policy 2025-02-17: Canary window of 48 hours in us-west-2 for Hosted API + Console UI; Dedicated customers will be notified and have a separate opt-in day for dedicated capacity changes. Automatic fallback to previous model variant if 3 consecutive Canary SLO breaches occur.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Performance regression from runtime kernel changes. Mitigation: limit kernel changes to canary only and require perf dashboard pass before full rollout.
Risk: Misaligned release notes across teams. Mitigation: mandatory 1-paragraph template and owner roster; weekly sync until scope lock.
Risk: Security signoff delay. Mitigation: early engage security with checklists and one dedicated review slot on 2025-02-19.
Risk: Dedicated customers opt-out. Mitigation: Provide clear opt-in schedule and rollback windows; run a separate dry-run with a pilot customer.
